configs.name: Big-CNN-C256-R8-H256-batch32
configs.inference: frozen CNN via Python MPS callback; native v1.9 handle supplies outcome-search protocol only

search: PUCT MCTS; per-config priors; exploration 1.5; reached-subtree reuse; maximum visits root choice
limits: Paired colors and shared seeds from the initial board; repeated paths possible. No Elo inference.

batchProtocol.backend: same C++ outcome MCTS and batch32 scheduler; v1.9 native single-thread Accelerate; CNN FP32 MPS callback

candidateInference.nativeHandle: v1.9 only for outcome protocol and policy-presence flag; every nonterminal candidate evaluation uses CNN callback

batchProtocol.modelSelection: v1.24 big CNN validation joint-loss minimum, epoch11; exact frozen teacher-cache checkpoint

stopReason: User requested stopping: CNN search sampling rate is much lower than v1.9
